title: Jedi Warriors in Action!
front_description: The spectacular battle begins. Mace Windu jumps into the arena, his lightsaber flashing. Soon he and Obi-Wan are fighting back-to-back, making scrap metal of their relentless droid attackers. In all directions there is frantic, violent conflict. Droids shoot relentlessly at the Jedi warriors, but these bolt assaults are swiftly deflected by lightsabers. Now joining in the struggle, Geonosian troops fire their more formidable sonic blasters at the Jedi.
back_description: Ewan McGregor, Samuel L. Jackson and Hayden Christensen brandish pre-ex lightsabers.
